pr.title: Integrate Rust runtime and review repairs for release/3.2
pr.body:
This partitions the oversized daemon, runtime, Codex adapter, Protect, encrypted store, supply-chain, CLI/test and dashboard families around the Rust runtime integration. Reviewed partitions fit within 500 physical lines per file. Ordered definitions, live facade lookups, descriptors, captured defaults and package anchors remain source-verified; policy/approval authority, receipt persistence and cleanup retain their existing contracts. CI repairs cover corpus scheduling, heredocs, source-location assertions and synthetic fixtures; independently resolved wheels require `anyio>=4.14.2`.

Current PR source: [`2564d9a4`](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/commit/2564d9a4dda22ff73e53e6dfae793ef95cbeb259), tree `0e36e80fd4e2cd0666323b0cb2a5704f5b2b4c04`. It retains the incoming navigation and adapter assertions, bounds corpus evaluation to four workers and sixteen tasks, and contains the actual generated 51,000-case report. The latest source change replaces only that report; the other 4,621 source files are unchanged from `0dd6f65c`.

| Validation and source scope | Actual result |
| --- | --- |
| [Current main CI](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/actions/runs/35454431259) | 111 jobs passed, including all 96 pytest shards; three jobs were skipped. The complete current-source census has 30 successful workflows and one failed workflow. |
| [Final immutable corpus on `2564`](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/actions/runs/35455773750) | Ten commands and eight contracts/all 24 phases passed. All 51,000 cases, 452 source bindings and committed report were checked unchanged. Two metric calls recorded 53.797/53.289 s and 313.383/313.773 MiB, within the original 60 s/512 MiB limits and 75 s child timeout. |
| [Current native smoke](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/actions/runs/35454431191) | Linux, ARM and Windows jobs passed. Intel failed c16 p99: **1,100.815 ms against 1,000 ms**; its other thirteen gates passed. Linux completed 100,000 requests, 250,000 receipts and zero errors. These smoke results do not satisfy the stricter original PRD qualification. |
| [Four partitions](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/actions/runs/35439228147) and [Codex follow-up](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/actions/runs/35440934952) | Protect 32, command 75, Surface 114 passed/one declared Darwin skip; Codex 21 existing cases plus nine separate controls passed. Collection, source, package and default secret-scan evidence remain separately attributed. |
| [StoreBase](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/actions/runs/35442131469) and [LSC installed controls](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/actions/runs/35444566127) | Store: 36 cases, scoped Ruff, types and source gates passed. LSC: 613 existing plus 25 source controls passed; 25 fresh installed-wheel controls passed with package/dependency identity unchanged. |
| [Package evaluator](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/actions/runs/35448416289) | Twelve unchanged controls and three route cases passed; the 17 earlier passes retain current collection/fixture/source bindings. All 21 type targets passed. |
| [SQLite/queue affected controls](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/actions/runs/35455408724) and [formatting closure](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/actions/runs/35457129639) | All 17 affected cases/51 phases passed on component source `b2b3`; that run failed solely on formatting. The subsequent seven-command formatter passed, preserving exact AST/token/literal/comment equivalence at source `55067860`. The other 152 historical passes have a source/fixture bridge. No fresh combined 169-case or installed qualification result is claimed. |
| [macOS endpoint diagnostics](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/actions/runs/35455096616) | ARM passed 83 cases and four native lookup children; two Python children reached their five-second poll deadlines. Intel failed clang discovery before tests. The [artifact reader](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/actions/runs/35456830917) passed; both original native failures remain. |

The [17:19 UTC evidence checkpoint](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/blob/36c9907096cf63edd359d3fdd3c667512017f02c/review-evidence/2026-09-19/pr2974-completion/addenda/2026-09-19T171945Z/README.md) preserves complete source/run identities, original failures and the separate earlier observation windows. The current generated CodeQL check remains failed with alert [386](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/security/code-scanning/386) open. Intel's measured cause remains unproved; the earlier per-process Store-cache explanation was withdrawn because the native fast path uses the existing parent daemon worker. No fresh Kilo result or external approval is claimed.

After that checkpoint, [corrected native-phase validation](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/actions/runs/35458614122) stopped in its source-equivalence check before environment setup, Rust compilation or tests. Its original AST-bridge failure is retained and being diagnosed. Earlier native-phase results remain 66 Python passes/seven failures, with zero Rust or real-native execution. RSP-100's four correctness witnesses passed while its unsafe optimization remains disabled. The inventory-join candidate and remaining workspace/native diagnostics are still unselected or under validation.

The [original PRD, TODO and Takeaway](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/tree/75bb8692b5eaaf6f2e138d5da20402b7d270a9bb/review-evidence/2026-09-19/pr2974-completion/originals) and [144-item worklist](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/blob/75bb8692b5eaaf6f2e138d5da20402b7d270a9bb/review-evidence/2026-09-19/pr2974-completion/TODO-current.md) preserve all 144 original task objects and 119 catalog entries: 74 claimed DONE, 31 OPEN, 29 BLOCKED and ten DEFERRED. All 74 claimed-DONE items retain unresolved acceptance dependencies; no task is promoted.

Release acceptance remains open: passing final-source CI and applicable findings, combined package/installed controls, the actual release-range secret scan, OCI trust-boundary/upstream decisions, fresh Greptile 5/5 and genuine independent last-push/CODEOWNER approval. Installed p95/p99 50/100 ms, c16 p99 200 ms, readiness 400 ms, original sampling, 30% benefit/5% regression limits, SQLite/process-tree attribution, workspace 1/10/100, resource/soak, rollback, signing and canary requirements remain unchanged. The [implementation worklist](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/blob/75bb8692b5eaaf6f2e138d5da20402b7d270a9bb/review-evidence/2026-09-19/pr2974-completion/NEXT-IMPLEMENTATION.md) records the remaining code, measurement and external dependencies.

comments.body: **Undefined AWS helper blocks loading** The AWS extraction removes the local `_aws` definition without importing it, but the retained `_AWS_SYNC = _aws(...)` assignment still executes at line 44. Importing the command catalog therefore raises `NameError`, preventing the daemon and hook command modules from loading. Remove the stale AWS constants and assignment now that `command_storage_aws_s3.py` owns those rules.

Addressed in `f8bae764`. Removed the stale `_AWS_SYNC = _aws(...)` assignment. The storage module now imports the AWS rules/specs from `command_storage_aws_s3` and includes them in the aggregate catalog; it has no `_aws` reference. [Published source](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/blob/f8bae76423f8120cb7c496f57407f7d47945f73d/src/codex_plugin_scanner/guard/runtime/command_storage_extensions.py#L7).

**Duplicate function breaks dashboard build** The merge leaves two identical module-level implementations of `focusVisibleDashboardSearch`, at lines 118 and 130. These duplicate declarations prevent `vite build` from building the dashboard. Keep one implementation alongside the new dashboard-location navigation helper.

Addressed in `f8bae764`. Kept one `focusVisibleDashboardSearch` implementation alongside the dashboard navigation helper. [Published source](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/blob/f8bae76423f8120cb7c496f57407f7d47945f73d/dashboard/src/app.tsx#L118). The [dashboard CI job](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/actions/runs/35377269052/job/105704788672) for this PR head passed Vite production build and four browser checks on merge `975967f4`.

**Missing provider import prevents mounting** The `PresentationModeProvider` import was removed, but the root render still uses `` at line 19. After the duplicate declaration is fixed, this entry point will throw `ReferenceError` before the dashboard mounts. Restore the import so the retained presentation-mode consumers remain connected to their provider. ```suggestion import { App } from "./app"; import { PresentationModeProvider } from "./presentation-mode-provider"; import "./tailwind-root.css"; ```

Addressed in `f8bae764`. Restored the `PresentationModeProvider` import; the root render still wraps `App` with that provider. [Published source](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/blob/f8bae76423f8120cb7c496f57407f7d47945f73d/dashboard/src/main.tsx#L5). The [dashboard CI job](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/actions/runs/35377269052/job/105704788672) for this PR head passed Vite production build and four browser checks on merge `975967f4`.

**Common CLI extensions are dropped** Replacing the common-CLI catalog entry with repo2nb drops the release branch’s non-core extensions, including Vault and Cloudflare, from the built-in registry.
